description: Sends the person’s XipFax draft to an office, by its office_id from find_fax_number, or to a fax number in the United States, its territories or Canada. Give document_ids, as finish_fax_file gave them, in the order you added them. It goes at once only where the person has a plan and chose Send straight away for you, when they connected you or since. Otherwise nothing is sent: the answer is a link where they look the fax over, send it and pay where they have no plan, so give them the link and never say it went. A draft with no pages, or with other pages than those you name or in another order, also answers a link, where they add or check them.

document_ids.description: The draft’s documents, as finish_fax_file gave them, in the order you added them.

fax_number.description: A fax number, with or without its +1: +1 202 555 0143.

office_id.description: The office, as find_fax_number gives it.

name: send_fax

anyOf.description: A fax of the person’s XipFax log.

cover_confidential.description: Whether its cover page was marked Confidential; false for a fax received.

direction.description: `sent` for a fax the person sent, `received` for one sent to their XipFax number.

failure.description: Why its last try failed: `no_answer`, `busy`, `call_dropped`, `declined`, `not_a_fax_number`, or `ours` for a failure on XipFax’s side. Null where none failed. An open set.

finished_at.description: When it was delivered or failed for good; null until then.

from_number.description: For a fax sent, the number it went from: the person’s own XipFax number where they have a plan, otherwise XipFax’s; null while the fax waits for them. For a fax received, the caller’s number, null where the caller’s line gave none.

office_id.description: The office it went to, by its id on XipFax’s list, as find_fax_number gives it; null for a number typed, and for a fax received.

pages.description: Its pages, the cover page among them.

amount_minor.description: In the currency’s smallest unit: cents.

price.description: What it costs: what its payment holds while it sends, and what was taken once it was delivered. Null for a fax sent on the plan or with a promo code, for one that failed, which costs nothing, and for a fax received.

retry_at.description: When it is tried again, while a failed try waits for the next; null otherwise.

sender_name.description: For a fax the person sent, the sender’s name its header line gave.

sent_at.description: When the person sent it; for a fax received, when it came.

status.description: Where it stands: `draft` for the person’s draft, read by its id until it is sent; `sending` until it is delivered or fails for good, then `delivered` or `failed`; `received` for a fax sent to their XipFax number. An open set: read what you know.

step.description: Where a fax being sent has got to: `queued`, `preparing` its pages, then `sending`; null for a draft, once it has ended, and for a fax received. An open set.

time_zone.description: The time zone its confirmation tells its times in, as the IANA database names it; null for a fax received.

to_number.description: The number it went to, `+1` and ten digits; for a fax received, the person’s own XipFax number it came to.

fax.description: The fax as XipFax’s log reads it, sent or waiting for the person; null where nothing could be sent as it stands.

paid_by.description: How a fax sent is paid: plan, its pages counted on the person’s plan. Null where nothing is sent. An open set.

result.description: sent: the fax is on its way, paid as paid_by says. waiting: nothing is sent: the person looks the fax over at url and sends it there, paying there where they have no plan. add_pages: the draft has no pages: the person adds them at url. look_over: the draft holds other pages than document_ids names, or the same in another order: the person checks it at url.

url.description: Where the person goes, unless the fax is sent: give them this link.

title: Send a fax
